scope: Actual CM divisor specialization and projective frame; auxiliary class field and projective tangent height, without certifying numerical orientation or F descent.

sources.title: Matthew Baker, Sam Payne and Joseph Rabinoff, On the structure of nonarchimedean analytic curves
sources.use: Annulus units, skeleton action, zero-counting slope formula, and node tubes.
sources.project_deduction: An ends-interchanging involution has two simple generic fixed points in characteristic zero, including residue characteristic 2.

sources.title: Akira Kurihara, On some examples of equations defining Shimura curves and the Mumford uniformization
sources.use: Integral quotient is smooth at an inverted node; reviewed scanned pages 287-288 again. Allows torsion at residue characteristic 2; invariants need not commute with reduction.
sources.snapshot_provenance: Same PDF recorded in D99; remote fetch failed, saved local scan inspected.

sources.title: Matthew Baker, Specialization of linear systems from curves to graphs
sources.use: Specialization of rank and canonical divisor class on a totally degenerate curve. No restriction excluding residue characteristic 2.

sources.title: John Voight, Shimura curve computations
sources.use: Hilbert-class-field definition and reciprocity for maximal-order CM points over general totally real F; Atkin-Lehner quotients defined over F.

sources.title: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory
sources.use: Local units and unramified abelian extensions; Hilbert class field and class group. Combined with D59 arithmetic to prove the common field has degree 272.

sources.title: Ravi Vakil, Foundations of Algebraic Geometry, Class 46
sources.use: Canonical embedding for a nonhyperelliptic smooth curve. The report also gives the Riemann-Roch tangent-separation argument.

prior_exact_inputs.use: Actual order, arithmetic Brandt graph, its metric lengths and Atkin-Lehner action, and geometric nonhyperellipticity.
Proved class number 17, exact CM ideal classes, proved 31-adic splitting group and bounded integral resolvent. Numerical orientation is not used.
Verified degree-17 integral order of discriminant 2^79 and integral trace-centered vectors; maximality not required.
Integral adjugate/Gaussian construction, uniform size bounds and stable CM fibre height below 41/10.
Exact candidate tangent, used only for the candidate-height and recognition-threshold diagnostic.

project_deductions: Two branch points from each of the nine inverted annuli; test every possible removal of P32.
Nine integer-potential and burning-order certificates exclude H0(K-D).
CM transitivity makes every evaluation cofactor nonzero.
Splitting field equals the CM Hilbert class field by the degree-16 resolvent and unramified cyclic degree-17 argument.
Any fixed bijection yields an H-frame, with a fifteen-chart tangent atlas of projective height below 10504.
Candidate projective height below 677; sufficient errors 10^-1320873 at one embedding or 10^-4857 at every embedding of H.
excluded_inferences: No certification of D59 numerical orientation
No chosen G12 nonvanishing or F-frame descent
No use of the disputed hyperellipticity premise or Dembele Theorem 6.1
No independent tangent evaluation, higher-jet equality, candidate identification or target field polynomial
